ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels in the central region against a 15% low-intensity black pixel boundary at the margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central expanse; solid black banding along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; isolated dark circular focal spots (5-7 visible) distributed sporadically across the white ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a narrow angle of approximately 40 degrees; clearly defined pixel convergence at the center point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration; continuous jagged peaks and valleys along the entire trailing boundary; most pronounced irregularity on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to convex distal tips; symmetrical outward sweep from the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered, high-contrast white-and-grey calcified structures (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; dark circular pitting clusters on the mid-lower ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible in the lower central region near the peduncle; minimal rake marks elsewhere.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on tip margins; multiple dark circular indentations across the white surface likely representing healed parasitic lesions or cookiecutter shark scars.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical structural ridges (pleats) visible near the waterline at the base of the fluke lobes.
